about: Hand-written layout of scene.castle-throne (F-14; ux/scenes/castle.md v1.0.2): plan metres, +x = east = into the castle (azimuth 90°), +y = north, the courtyard floor at z = 0. Rotation 0, so glTF x = plan x and glTF z = -plan y. West to east: the gate passage, the courtyard with four porticoes (two rows of columns on the north side), the throne hall (x -6..16, y -7..7, 8 m high) with the throne on a 0.9 m dais facing west. One place (place.castle); spots in UX order: king-throne first (the king has no beat that places him), hostage-visit second, everything else auto: false. Spots and furnishings as castle.md v1.1 (3.1, 4): the north portico's two rows line up, the vigil landing hostage-near stands between two front columns; the hall's floor ends at the foot of the steps and the dais is an island of its own for the king (navRoots). lamps: the baked lights (build_castle.py) and the page's flames read the same list. hall: the inside of the throne hall, where the page takes out the sky's light (F-14 3).

walkable.name: the gate apron and the gate passage
the throne hall up to the foot of the steps (x 9.8; the player does not go up, castle.md 3.1)

exits.about: out through the gate, down the steps to the square

king-throne.about: the king on his throne, on the dais; the first spot characters take on their own (the king has no beat that places him)

hostage-visit.about: in the courtyard, in front of and a little west of the hostage: where people who come to see him stand

gate-in.about: landing from the square (place.castle startSpots); the camera behind it sits in the gate passage, pulled in

melos-led-in.about: beat.04: where Melos appears when he is led in, bound, between two guards; he walks the navmesh to before-king

before-king.about: beat.04's relocate: Melos before the steps, a guard on either side at (5, ±1.6)

companion-aside.about: the player who came in with him stands aside here, 4 m behind Melos's left, south of the axis (castle.md v1.1 4: from here the indoor camera has Melos and the king both in frame); 「保証する」 is said from here

selinuntius-in.about: beat.06: where Selinuntius appears inside the door, then walks to selinuntius-meet

selinuntius-meet.about: beat.06's relocate: face to face with Melos; they embrace, then he is bound

hostage-column.about: beat.07's relocate: Selinuntius bound to the second-row column of the north portico (-12.5, 8), facing the courtyard, in shade all day

hostage-near.about: exit.1.vigil landing (「城に残り、セリヌンティウスのそばにいる」), between two front columns, about 1.35 m from the hostage (castle.md v1.1 4); the camera behind it stands in the open courtyard

hostage-guard.about: where the page puts the hostage's guards (char.guards is a group and takes no spot; the data does not write this one)

way.plaza.about: out through the gate to the square; people leaving fade out here
